A teller you can ask "where did you hear this" can also answer confidently and wrongly, and a provenance field in a memory store can be written by the same process that wrote the bad claim. Asking the source only helps when the answer can be checked against something the source does not control. There is a second route to trust that skips the teller entirely: re-derivation.
